technology_name: Biological Pest Control Technology for Arecanut Farms
problem_solved: Need for environmentally safe and sustainable pest control in arecanut farms.
description: Kalpa EPN Aqua Formulation Technology involves the production of entomopathogenic nematodes (EPN) and their host insect, Galleria mellonella, along with the packaging of nematodes. The technology facilitates the production of fresh quantities of EPN as required, promoting environmentally safe and sustainable pest control in arecanut farms.
applications:
Biological pest management in arecanut plantations
Production of eco-friendly biocontrol agents
Integrated pest management (IPM) programs
Sustainable crop protection practices
Commercial production and supply of entomopathogenic nematodes
